text.p: Austrian building materials maker Wienerberger Baustoffindustrie said it expects full-year pretax earnings of between 1.2 billion and 1.4 billion schillings, down from 1.495 billion in 1995.

"The originally expected 1.4 billion schillings is still within reach," chief executive Erhard Schaschl told journalists. He said he was forecasting a range to take account of the possibility of another severe winter.

The brickmaker earlier reported a 20 percent drop in nine-month pretax earnings to 1.041 billion schillings, blaming a colder-than-expected winter and a general downturn in the European construction industry. -- Vienna newsroom +431 53112 274
